headline: Congress goes quiet with brief pro forma sessions and zero floor action as lawmakers prepare for Thursday reconvening.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session for 30 seconds on Monday morning, October 19, with no legislative business conducted. The chamber adjourned immediately and will reconvene Thursday.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House convened briefly on Monday morning for just 2 minutes with Speaker pro tempore Goldman presiding. Fifteen new bills and five resolutions were introduced, but no votes or substantive floor action occurred before adjournment.
